experiment: TRA category-centre transfer on recorded cases (scratch, static)

inputs.item_bank: scripts/tra_items.py (build_items), teaching material: type_label + taught_exemplars only

method.centre: mean of unit GloVe vectors of the first k taught r2 objects per slot (one-k-per-item), pooled by type_label
method.tiebreak_score: cosine(unit(slot_centre), unit(vec(type_label))) only when top-2 margin < 0.10; 5/6 labels OOV
method.confidence_variant: unit r2 vectors weighted by stored confidence where a recorded typed edge exists; separate confidence-only arm has TRA-label coverage 0
method.domain_arm: cosine(unit(vec(candidate)), slot_centre) with taught r2 excluded; foil/negative correct == None
method.permutation: 2 deterministic hash shuffles; any changed pick -> None
method.no_oracle: no type_sets, world_model, gold, or query-subject type in any scorer input; gold used only to grade after scoring
method.instrument_caveat: exact-centre sanity FAILS the 0.10 margin (6/6 top-1 correct at score 1.0 but margins 0.020-0.087): the centres are not separable at the frozen gate. A margin=0 wiring sanity (instrument-only) passes 6/6. Near/far nulls are fail-closed non-separability, not a demonstrated capability failure of a working gate.

instrument_sanity_centre_as_subject.label: contrast-case
instrument_sanity_centre_as_subject.note: FAILS at the pre-registered 0.10 margin; see centre_separation for the geometry

wiring_sanity_centre_as_subject_no_margi.note: instrument-only: margin=0.0 ONLY in this probe; proves the scorer is connected, never used as a capability result

k0_items.note: these items contribute no taught exemplars to their own slot centre
